description: Scrape jobs from Greenhouse company boards by token, board URL, job URL, company name or domain. Get structured pay, locations, departments, questions and dates.

companies.description: Board tokens, board URLs, embed URLs, job URLs, company names or domains. Examples: "stripe", "https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/figma", "Airbnb", "jobs.elastic.co".
companies.title: Companies

content.description: Include the full job description. Departments and offices are always included (fetched separately when descriptions are off).
content.title: Include job descriptions

departments.description: Keep jobs in departments that contain any of these words, e.g. Engineering, Sales.
departments.title: Departments

descriptionFormat.description: Format used when Include job descriptions is on. HTML is always the content field; text/markdown add contentText/contentMarkdown.
descriptionFormat.title: Description format

employmentType.description: Keep full-time, part-time, contract, internship or temporary roles when the employer states it.
employmentType.title: Employment type

excludeTitleKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these words (case-insensitive).
excludeTitleKeywords.title: Job title must not contain

includeQuestions.description: Fetch each job's application form questions. Adds one request per emitted job.
includeQuestions.title: Include application questions

jobUrls.description: Full Greenhouse job URLs to fetch one by one. A company board URL alone is not enough; include /jobs/<id>.
jobUrls.title: Job URLs (mode=jobDetails)

locations.description: Keep jobs whose location or office contains any of these words, e.g. Remote, London, New York.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job or company records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxJobsPerCompany.description: Cap jobs per company after filters (mode=companyJobs). 0 means no per-company cap.
maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company

minAnnualSalary.description: Keep jobs whose base pay reaches at least this yearly amount. Hourly, monthly and weekly ranges are annualized.
minAnnualSalary.title: Minimum annual salary

mode.description: What to fetch: jobs from company boards, specific job URLs, or company board lookup.
enumTitles: Specific jobs by URL or ID
All jobs from company boards (legacy alias)
Specific job by company + ID (legacy alias)
mode.title: Mode

onlyWithSalary.description: Keep only jobs with a published or clearly stated pay range.
onlyWithSalary.title: Only jobs with salary

publishedAfter.description: Keep jobs first published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
publishedAfter.title: Published after

salaryCurrency.description: Only keep jobs with pay in this currency. Use Any to ignore currency.
salaryCurrency.title: Salary currency

searchQuery.description: Name or token text to match against the built-in company directory. Leave empty to resolve the Companies list instead.
searchQuery.title: Company search (mode=companySearch)

titleKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these words (case-insensitive).
titleKeywords.title: Job title must contain

updatedAfter.description: Keep jobs last updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
updatedAfter.title: Updated after

verifyCompanies.description: Check each company against the live board and report its open-job count.
verifyCompanies.title: Verify companies live (mode=companySearch)

workplaceType.description: Keep remote, hybrid or on-site roles. Jobs without a stated arrangement are dropped when this is not Any.
workplaceType.title: Workplace type

title: Greenhouse Jobs Scraper Input
